cards.design_implication: Designs relying on similar gravitational-wave networks should anticipate that component mass and distance parameters can be estimated with the reported asymmetric error ranges for detected binary black holes.
does_not_establish: The causal mechanism of the mergers.
The statistical methods used to derive the uncertainty intervals.
Generalizability to other detector networks or observing runs.
cards.evidence_excerpt: The detected binary black holes have total masses between 18.6 − 0.7 + 3.2 M ⊙ and 84.4 − 11.1 + 15.8 M ⊙ and range in distance between 320 − 110 + 120 and 2840 − 1360 + 1400 Mpc .
limitations: Applies only to the specific binary black hole events detected in O1 and O2.
Does not define the instrument calibration or exact detection algorithm settings.
cards.statement: The source text reports that binary black hole detections had total masses between specific bounds and ranged in distance between specific bounds.

cards.design_implication: Similar studies may structure their search campaigns around defined observing runs (O1 and O2) to assess detection yields over specific time periods.
does_not_establish: The specific statistical bias correction methods used.
The ethical or reproducibility protocols employed.
The exact number of marginal candidates screened prior to the final selection.
cards.evidence_excerpt: We present the results from three gravitational-wave searches for coalescing compact binaries with component masses above 1 M ⊙ during the first and second observing runs of the advanced gravitational-wave detector network.
limitations: Abstract-level description of the study scope; does not detail the internal data analysis pipeline.
Specifies a component mass cutoff (>1 M⊙) but does not elaborate on other exclusion criteria.
cards.statement: The study presents results from gravitational-wave searches for coalescing compact binaries during the first and second observing runs of the advanced gravitational-wave detector network.

cards.design_implication: Studies modeling NSBH merger rates using this dataset must treat the observed count as zero and account for the non-detection limit rather than a measured rate.
does_not_establish: The comparison controls used to rule out background noise.
cards.evidence_excerpt: No neutron star–black hole mergers were detected.
limitations: Limited to the sensitivity range of the detector network during O1 and O2.
Does not establish that such mergers do not exist, only that none were detected in this specific search.
cards.statement: No neutron star–black hole mergers were detected in the analyzed datasets from O1 and O2.
